artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan reconciling the typst extension's declared scope and keyword_overrides (Part 1) and fixing chapter-quality-check.sh Rule 1.3 bibliography resolution plus skipped-BLOCKING surfacing (Part 2), with an end-to-end acceptance-verification phase; 5.25h estimated.

memory_candidates.content: Extension keyword_overrides in agent-system/extensions/*/manifest.json are matched by jq test("\\b" + keyword + "\\b") inside task-type-detect.sh step 2, so a multi-word keyword only matches its exact contiguous singular form: \btypst chapter\b is FALSE for 'review the typst chapters' because the trailing s destroys the closing word boundary. Any keyword whose head noun is commonly pluralized in task descriptions needs both forms registered. Separately, typst's core weak-signal entry (step 4) holds exactly one keyword ('typst') and step 4 requires >=2 distinct matches, so typst can NEVER resolve via the weak-signal table -- keyword_overrides is the only viable fix point for typst mis-detection, and 'chapter'/'textbook' are already weak signals for general, which is what makes chapter/manual work fall through to general.
